items.title: More assault allegations surface against footballers in tiny town of Balmoral
items.description: More women come forward with allegations of sexual assault in a small Victorian town, years after a rape victim was shunned by the town.

items.title: Breaking: Trump hikes global tariff rate to 15pc after Supreme Court loss
items.description: Donald Trump says he will raise to 15 per cent the global tariff he imposed after the US Supreme Court ruled against previous tariffs.

items.title: America's vaccine wars are shaking Australia, driven by 'sticky' myth
items.description: With immunisation rates declining and outbreaks of infectious diseases like measles increasing, the consequences of vaccine hesitancy in Australia are becoming clearer.

items.title: Why this 'stubborn bugger' sued his bank for $379 million
items.description: Ian Williams has brought a whole new meaning to "taking on the big guy". When scammers stole from the pensioner the bank blamed him. So he launched a $379 million lawsuit to "make it right".

items.title: High-spending premiers appear immune to inflation pressure
items.description: High-spending premiers remain popular and seemingly impervious to the rising cost-of-living anxiety piling pressure on the Albanese government.

items.title: A close look at the price patterns that landed Coles in court
items.description: The pricing patterns of these six products show how Coles stands accused of using its Down Down marketing campaign to dupe shoppers.

items.title: 'She left a ticking timebomb': Elizabeth, Andrew and the monarchy's future
items.description: It will be up to King Charles to shepherd his family's institution through its darkest hour. But could his own mother have done more to snuff out this crisis before he inherited it?

items.title: The dreams behind the doors Epstein promised to open
items.description: Admission into elite universities. A job that promised travel around the world. An audition for Victoria’s Secret. This is how Jeffery Epstein lured his victims.

items.title: Doctors race through Kyiv missile strike to deliver child's donor heart
items.description: Kyiv surgeons who drove through a massive missile strike to deliver a child's donor heart say they will stop at nothing to save lives — even when under attack.

items.title: Amid power struggles in Syria, a window opened for the 'ISIS brides'
items.description: After holding a large swathe of autonomous territory that included two detention camps, Kurdish-led forces are now reluctantly handing over control to Syrian government forces, following their successful military offensive.

items.title: Live: Aussies eye off Olympic bobsleigh history, Brown's final postponed
items.description: Bree Walker and Kiara Reddingius are on the verge of making Australian Olympic history, as teenager Indra Brown is forced to wait for her chance to compete for a medal. Follow live.

items.title: The dirty little secret economists never want to mention
items.description: The theory goes that if you have just the right amount of workers on the unemployment scrap heap, you can keep inflation in check. The problem is that no-one knows exactly what the magic unemployment rate is.

items.title: Coastal town records hottest day ever but locals say BOM data is wrong
items.description: Can a weather station that is 10 kilometres away from a coastal town centre give an accurate forecast? These locals think not.

items.title: Australia's Yerin Ha is living her own Cinderella story with Bridgerton
items.description: Yerin Ha built a name for herself in local and international productions for almost a decade before transforming into Bridgerton's newest paramour.

items.title: Think you're a trivia boss? Show us what you've got
items.description: Well, this is cute — you thinking you're a quiz pro. It's time to play … HARD!

items.title: The Miracle on Ice, when an unheralded USA team knocked off the mighty USSR
items.description: On this day in 1980, a group of American students pulled off the most unlikely of victories, beating the greatest team in international ice hockey history in the upset of the century. Some even called it a miracle.

items.title: As erosion costs climb these coastal communities consider retreat
items.description: With costs and damage mounting, councils are considering all options, including pulling back from the beaches.

items.title: Hungary and Slovakia threaten Ukraine over stalled Russian oil shipments
items.description: Hungary and Slovakia, which have both received a temporary exemption from an EU policy prohibiting imports of Russian oil, have accused Ukraine of deliberately holding up supplies.

items.title: NASA boss blasts Boeing and space agency for botched Starliner flight
items.description: A bungled Boeing mission that left two astronauts stranded on the International Space Station for nine months has been criticised by NASA's new boss.

items.title: Fans flock to Japan zoo to see viral baby monkey Punch
items.description: The six month old macaque's relationship with a soft toy orangutan has become an internet sensation.

items.title: Anna Murdoch-Mann, ex-wife of Rupert Murdoch, dies aged 81
items.description: The author, journalist and philanthropist was Rupert Murdoch's "active partner" in his media empire News Corp over their 31-year marriage.

items.title: Buy-out offer for Wang Fuk Court owners in Hong Kong
items.description: After a deadly Hong Kong fire that killed 168 people and left thousands homeless in November, authorities have announced a buy-out offer for owners.

items.title: After more than 50 years, humans are set to return to the Moon
items.description: NASA's Artemis II mission may launch in early March. If successful, it will be the first time humans have flown beyond the Moon in more than 50 years.

items.title: Gout comes so close to breaking 10-second barrier, sets another record
items.description: Australian sprinting sensation Gout Gout comes perilously close to breaking the 10-second barrier, with another eye-catching run in Brisbane.

items.title: Yoon Suk Yeol's insurrection conviction completes a scandalous downfall
items.description: Former South Korean president Yoon Suk Yeol's sentence for insurrection comes after a tumultuous era of shamanism, Chanel bags and conspiracy theories.
